entities.summary: Tyyne Lilja Leivo-Larsson was a Finnish Ambassador and MP. She was the first Finnish woman to serve as Ambassador in Oslo from 1958 to 1966 and as Envoy to Reykjavík in 1958–1964 and the first Nordic woman, who led the government when she served as Deputy Prime Minister for Reino Kuuskoski in 1958.
